name: LICET 15
tagline:
15 years of building engineers.
One mark that says it all.
description: A commemorative visual identity for Loyola-ICAM College of Engineering & Technology, Chennai, marking their 15th anniversary. The logomark is constructed from the numeral 15 with the college's top-view floor plan embedded in the negative space — a hidden blueprint.
approach: Built using the brand's signature deep navy blue and amber orange, the mark is minimal, geometric and meaningful. Every angle, every line references the institutional architecture — turning a number into a monument.

gallery.caption: The complete wordmark system — LICET 15, with the college motto integrated beneath.
A tessellated pattern derived from the logomark, built for large-format applications.

colors.name: Navy Blue
colors.psychology: Represents academic excellence, trust, and institutional authority. Navy conveys depth and seriousness — the foundation of a 15-year legacy.

colors.name: Amber Orange
colors.psychology: Symbolizes energy, warmth, and forward momentum. The amber counterbalances the navy's formality with optimism and approachability.

colors.name: Pure White
colors.psychology: Provides breathing room and clarity. White space is not emptiness — it is the canvas that gives the mark its architectural precision.

colors.name: Deep Black
colors.psychology: Used for mono applications and high-contrast scenarios. Black adds gravitas and ensures the mark reads powerfully at any scale.

typography.description: A realist sans-serif typeface designed by Geoffrey Lee in 1965. Impact's ultra-condensed, heavy letterforms command immediate attention — engineered for headlines that demand to be read. Its unapologetic weight delivers the institutional gravitas LICET 15's anniversary identity requires.

name: SANS
tagline:
Built for speed.
Designed to dominate.
description: A bold brand identity for SANS — Supreme Agility Net Sport, a badminton sports brand. The logomark is born from the jump smash — the most aggressive, airborne strike in badminton — captured mid-flight and distilled into a geometric mark. Sharp, angular, and built for motion. Set in Brother Oblique to reinforce the dynamic, forward-leaning energy of competitive sport. The neo green and charcoal palette cuts through the noise — electric on court, unmistakable off it.
approach: The identity system is engineered around tension and release. The jump smash logomark carries diagonal momentum — every angle references the explosive upward leap and downward strike. Brother Oblique's italic construction mirrors that same forward pressure. The neo green isn't decorative — it's adrenaline made visible.

gallery.caption: The logomark across the full colorway system — charcoal, neo green, royal blue, and sunset red. Built to flex, built to dominate.

colors.name: Neo Green
colors.psychology: The signature colour. Neo green is adrenaline — raw, electric, impossible to ignore. It captures the explosive energy of a jump smash and the relentless intensity of competitive badminton.

colors.name: Charcoal Grey
colors.psychology: The grounding force. Charcoal provides the serious, performance-grade backbone of the identity — technical, controlled, and unapologetically premium.

colors.name: Carbon Black
colors.psychology: Used for deep backgrounds and high-contrast applications. Carbon black creates the void against which neo green burns brightest — dominance through depth.

colors.name: Pure White
colors.psychology: The counterforce. White delivers clarity and precision. On dark surfaces, it makes the logomark cut like a blade — sharp, clean, undeniable.

typography.description: A bold, forward-leaning display typeface that mirrors the diagonal momentum of competitive sport. Brother Oblique's italic construction captures the same aggressive energy as the jump smash — every letter leans into the action.

name: Solestice Pick
description: Solestice Pick is an e-commerce brand that curates high-quality products and offers them at affordable prices. The positioning is “premium for affordable people” — combining aspirational quality with accessibility.
approach: The logo represents a thumb and index finger holding an object, symbolizing careful product selection and quality assurance. The overall form subtly resembles a shopping bag, reinforcing the e-commerce identity.

gallery.caption: The brand imagery evokes warmth and honesty, establishing the accessible premium positioning.
The brand pattern deployed as an asset across the packaging landscape.
Secondary monogram logo preserving the idea of careful selection.

colors.name: Forest Dawn
colors.psychology: Trust, quality, and a calm premium feel. This colour grounds the brand in reliability and aspirational value.

colors.name: Sunlit Cream
colors.psychology: Warmth, friendliness, and youthful energy. When paired with the deep teal, it establishes an accessible premium positioning that welcomes the user.

typography.description: Adelle is a slab serif typeface that blends modern readability with traditional strength. It adds a premium editorial tone while maintaining clarity, making it suitable for a brand that communicates trust and quality.

name: FOOTGRAPHY
tagline:
Step into the future.
AI Product Photography.
description: A comprehensive exploration of AI product photography for 'Footgraphy'. This project demonstrates the power of generative AI to create hyper-realistic, high-fidelity concepts for slippers and shoes. By crafting precise prompts, we established a visual narrative that seamlessly blends rich South Indian traditional aesthetics with modern, contemporary design.
approach: Our approach reimagines cultural heritage for a modern audience. The photography style draws deep inspiration from South Indian traditions—incorporating authentic textures, earthy tones, and cultural motifs—while maintaining the sleek, dramatic lighting of high-end editorial photography. Each generated image acts as a striking, commercially viable piece that elevates everyday footwear.

gallery.caption: High-contrast editorial lighting highlighting material texture.
Vibrant global-fashion aesthetic captured entirely through generative AI.
The raw intent of design, crystallized in synthetic light.

name: Tarak Food Products
tagline:
Fresh South Indian Favourites.
Made for modern homes.
description: Tarak Food Products brings fresh, ready-to-cook batters, traditional sweets, crunchy snacks, and flavourful masala podis to everyday homes. We designed a vibrant digital experience to communicate their commitment to quality, tradition, and freshness, leveraging premium animations and rich visuals.
approach: The website blends modern typography with a warm, appetizing color palette, reflecting the rich flavors of South Indian cuisine. A focus on high-performance animations, including magnetic mouse hovering effects and smooth scroll transitions, delivers a premium feel without sacrificing accessibility. Behind the scenes, we developed a powerful custom admin portal that allows their team to seamlessly manage inventory, orders, and product catalogs.

name: Antique Shop Photography
description: An AI-driven product photography project for an antique and decor shop in Chennai. The goal was to generate hyper-realistic, culturally rich visuals that highlight intricate craftsmanship without traditional photoshoots. By carefully crafting AI prompts, we achieved a vintage, cinematic look for Cape Kamoryn, a brand specializing in curated antique decor.
approach: We used generative AI to produce high-end editorial visuals. The aesthetic blends South Indian antique warmth—earthy woods, aged brass, and rich textures—with contemporary styling. This approach allowed Cape Kamoryn to showcase their decor pieces in a premium, atmospheric setting, emphasizing their rich heritage.
